verdicts.why: The MCU wiki dates the hunt for Frank Castle that drives One Last Kill to mid-2028 and lists the special among the 2028 timeline's pending entries; the 2027 page covers Born Again S2 but not this special.

Brand New Day (released July 31, 2026) is set four years after the world forgets Peter, linked to 2028, and stays in his own New York with no multiverse travel, so 'Across the multiverse' does not hold through it.
The plot opens 'In an alternate 1960s' on Earth-828; without this stage First Steps would inherit the 2028 stage.
Marvel Zombies is set in the Zombie Outbreak reality five years after the 2018 outbreak, linked to 2023/Zombie Outbreak, not in the S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 timeline.
Team Thor: Part 1 is set in 2016 during the Avengers' Civil War, and Team Darryl's plot opens 'In 2018' with Darryl moving to Los Angeles.
MODOK does not appear: two Hydra scientists (Dr. Cruller and Dr. Fump) enlist the Abomination to capture the Hulk and drain his gamma energy into their own arc reactor, which produces Zzzax.

The Avengers never travel in time: Thanos uses the stolen Quantum Tunnel to bring Iron Monger, Ultron and a past Red Skull to the present, and the team tracks the van to Hydra's island base and beats them there.
